mkp-charts:chart@1.name: chart
mkp-charts:chart@1.about: A bar, line, dot, area or stem chart of one or more series in a frame, with a light grid, numbered axes and their names, and a key in the bar.

inputs.name: kind
inputs.about: how each point is drawn

inputs.name: data
inputs.about: one series of points

inputs.name: name
inputs.about: the name of that series (for the key and the table)

inputs.name: series
inputs.about: more series, each in the next colour

inputs.name: title
inputs.about: the frame's title; empty: what is plotted against what

inputs.name: xlabel
inputs.about: what x measures

inputs.name: ylabel
inputs.about: what y measures

inputs.name: cats
inputs.about: names for x = 0, 1, 2 …, shown instead of numbers

inputs.name: zero
inputs.about: keep 0 on the y axis

inputs.name: size
inputs.about: how tall the plot is for its width: s short, m, l tall

value.expr: if(len(data) > 0, [{name: name, data: data}], []) + map(series, s => {name: s.name, data: s.data})

values.name: ylo
comment: y: nice ticks around the data (and 0)

value.expr: min(floor(ylo/ystep) ystep, ylo - if(yhi > ylo, 0, ystep))
max(ceil(yhi/ystep) ystep, yhi + if(yhi > ylo, 0, ystep))

values.name: xlo
comment: x: bars get a band around each x; marks get a little room at the ends

value.expr: if(len(ux) > 1, min(map(range(1, len(ux) - 1), k => ux[k] - ux[k - 1])), 1)
if(kind == bar, band/2, if(kind == dot or kind == stem, max(band/2, (xhi - xlo)/25), if(xhi > xlo, 0, 1)))
if(len(cats) > 0 or (kind == bar and len(ux) <= 16), ux, ticks(xlo, xhi, nicestep(max(xhi - xlo, 1)/5)))

values.name: asp
comment: the view: the plot area x0..x1 by y0..y1, with room left of it for the y numbers, under it for
the x ones and the x axis's name, and over it for the y axis's name

values.name: fname
comment: the x axis's name gets a margin of its own past the plot's right end (some 8 a letter)

values.name: px
comment: a pixel, about, each way (a lesson column is some 720 wide)

values.name: chtone
values.body: if(mod(k, 4) == 0, info, if(mod(k, 4) == 1, warn, if(mod(k, 4) == 2, ok, bad)))
comment: the colour of the k-th series: blue, orange, green, red, then round again (accent is the host's
own ink in some hosts, so a series never takes it)

value.expr: kind == dot or kind == stem or (kind == line and len(pts) <= 30 ns)

values.name: bw
comment: bars: each series takes a slice of the band

values.name: area
values.body: [(first(sort(all[si].data, p => p.x), 1)[0].x, base)] + line(si) + [(last(sort(all[si].data, p => p.x), 1)[0].x, base)]

value.expr: join(map(filter(all, s => s.name != ""), s => s.name), " and ") + if(len(filter(all, s => s.name != "")) == 0, ylabel, "") + if(xlabel != "" and (ylabel != "" or len(filter(all, s => s.name != "")) > 0), " by " + xlabel, "")
if(heading != "", heading, "chart") + ": a " + kind + " chart of " + join(map(all, s => if(s.name != "", s.name, "the data")), ", ")

comment: a light grid: across at each y tick, and up at each x tick unless the marks are bars
the axes along the bottom and left, the zero line when 0 is inside, tick marks

md.expr:
if(title != "", "**" + title + "**

", "") + "| " + if(xlabel != "", xlabel, "x") + " | " + join(map(all, s => if(s.name != "", s.name, if(ylabel != "", ylabel, "y"))), " | ") + " |
" + "|---|" + join(map(all, s => "---:"), "|") + "|
" + join(map(ux, x => "| " + xtext(x) + " | " + join(map(all, s => join(map(filter(s.data, p => p.x == x), p => "" + p.y), ", ")), " | ") + " |"), "
")
